units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19:2">Lev. R. s. 19</cite> <he>פתר קרא בת׳ זו של עפר וכ׳</he> interpreted the verse (<cite ref="Song of Songs 5:11">Cant. V, 11</cite>) by comparison to a mound of earth (that was to be levelled) &c.; Cant. R. l. c. <he>בתלוליות</he> (corr. acc.); Yalk. ib. 989 (not <cite ref="G00078"><he>זה</he></cite>); Midr. Sam. ch. V (not <he>בתלילות</he>).

<cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 16:1">Tosef. Ohol. XVI, 1</cite> <he>ואיזו היא ת׳ זו של עפר וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="V00581"><he>תלולות</he></cite>) and what is called a mound (with regard to levitical uncleanness)? A mound of earth by the side of a trench.—Pl. <he>תְּלוּלִיּוֹת</he>. Ohol. XVI, 3 <he>הת׳ הקרובות וכ׳</he> mounds which are near a town or a road; <cite ref="Ketubot 20b:2">Keth. 20ᵇ</cite>; Tosef. Ohol. l. c. (not <cite ref="V00581"><he>תלולות</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 7:2:9">Y. Naz. VII, 56ᶜ</cite> top. Cant. R. l. c., v. supra.
